archetype_rationale: Commercializes vLLM, the open-source LLM inference engine - developer infrastructure.

1.evidence: article: vLLM is open source - deployment/optimization uses commodity stack

2.evidence: inference serving fully achievable with OSS vllm/sglang; no proprietary R&D needed

3.evidence: 'serve one model cheaply on your GPU fleet' is a small sellable scope

4.evidence: GPU cluster/K8s integration complexity real but standard

5.evidence: open weights + client models; no external data dependency

14.evidence: client needs platform engineer, not ML team

15.evidence: article mission 'cheaper and faster' inference = direct cost anchor

16.evidence: MLOps/infra consultancies bill $50k+ for LLM-serving builds

22.evidence: article: a16z + Lightspeed co-led; Sequoia, Altimeter, Redpoint

24.evidence: inference-cost optimization is a top enterprise pain 2026

26.evidence: site thin; OSS repo is the real proof

28.evidence: vLLM itself open - moat is operational scale

29.evidence: GPU hardware dependency at clients, managed remotely

30.evidence: open source - no data moat blocking agencies

35.evidence: client prompts flow through; standard care needed

40.evidence: self-hosting enterprises identifiable via job posts/oss usage

44.evidence: managed platforms (Bedrock etc.) compete for the same spend

45.evidence: serving layer persists regardless of model winner

46.evidence: OSS tooling commoditizes fast; services persist

49.evidence: many MSPs can learn vLLM; margin pressure

52.evidence: vLLM community + funded adopters are warm leads

agency_play.build_scope: Partial functionality: private LLM-serving stacks for mid-market firms using OSS vLLM - model selection, quantization, autoscaling, cost dashboards - Inferact's exact domain without building the engine.
agency_play.packaging: Fixed-scope 'Private GPT in 30 days' deployment package; inference-cost-audit upsell; managed-SLO retainer.
agency_play.first_clients: Series B+ SaaS and fintechs whose per-seat API bills exploded and whose lawyers want data residency.
